scope: Repository-code-free, collision-output-free feasibility and no-go review. This contract does not authorize PR-01, a collision evaluator, T01-T12, Radau, trajectory, endpoint, Rust, JAX development, F-11, QKE, unblinding, or public runtime work.

status_boundary.next_authority_if_pass: A separate explicit OWNER-1 decision is required.

baseline_evidence.external_test_scope: Synthetic mechanism and kill tests only; no RABBIT import or physical collision output.

common_conventions.units: Natural units c=hbar=k_B=1; energy, momentum, mass, and temperature are MeV.
common_conventions.physical_metric: g_phys=diag(-1,+1,+1,+1); future-directed on-shell p has p0>0 and p.p=-m^2.
common_conventions.occupation: eta=log(f/(1-f)); f=1/(1+exp(-eta)); strict interior 0<f<1. No clipping.
common_conventions.entropy_affinity: A=log(F/R)=eta1+eta2-eta3-eta4; J*A>=0 for strict interior occupations.
common_conventions.finite_me_shell: Use the process-total finite-m_e COM shell and physical-right threshold convention frozen in W6; generic cleared-root substitution is forbidden.
common_conventions.b3_comparison: Novelty is assessed against the sealed global B3 polynomial basis, finite Y_max plus tail ledger, mass solve, event trace, and A0-A4 arithmetic graph as a whole.

negative_control.statement: Let V=span{phi_1,...,phi_n} over finite real coefficients. If every phi_i has limit zero as xi approaches 1 from below, then every v in V has limit zero. Hence V cannot contain the constant function 1 on a terminal interval and cannot contain p_star*xi/(1-xi).
assumptions: Expansion coefficients are finite constants independent of xi.
Every terminal-cell basis function has a finite endpoint limit equal to zero.
Exact representation means pointwise equality on a nonempty terminal interval.
negative_control.required_outcome: pass means the no-go theorem is proved. Failure to prove it is INCONCLUSIVE, not evidence that the same-space design works.
negative_control.corollary: The external PCR-DG wording is FAIL-AS-WRITTEN under a same trial/test-space reading. A distinct test space or analytic invariant component is a materially new candidate and must close its own stability and authority obligations.

candidate_universe.description: A terminal-vanishing trial space and a distinct conservative test space containing exact 1 and p.
required_exact_properties: A fully specified trial/test pairing and local mass map.
A uniform inf-sup lower bound over the declared state and cell domain.
A discrete fermionic entropy inequality derived for the nonsymmetric pairing.
Exact conservative tests without a post-hoc projection.
One full-domain tail semantics and process-total finite-m_e shell.
terminal_falsifiers: The inf-sup bound can vanish inside the declared domain.
Entropy requires a symmetric positive mass matrix that the Petrov pairing does not supply.
Conservation uses a correction or projection outside the weak form.
The test function p makes the compactified weak pairing divergent.
Any required property is deferred to implementation choice.

candidate_universe.description: A single analytic equilibrium/invariant component plus terminal-vanishing local perturbations.
required_exact_properties: One total representation owns equilibrium, invariant tests, compactified endpoint, and tail.
The analytic component and local perturbations have a unique differentiable coefficient map.
Exact conservation and entropy follow before numerical quadrature.
No finite Y_max, zero extension, lost-event ledger, or second tail consumer exists.
The generated operation graph is not isomorphic to B3-v2.
terminal_falsifiers: The analytic component is a separate tail oracle or correction surface.
A consumer can bypass the canonical representation.
The coefficient map is singular or discontinuous.
The design reproduces B3 under a basis/domain change.
Any required property is deferred to implementation choice.

candidate_universe.description: A moving-lattice/remap microreversible finite-state energy DVM.
required_exact_properties: Exact on-shell forward/reverse edges across the continuous frozen temperature domain.
Nonnegative symmetric conductances and a finite-state fermionic H-theorem.
A remap theorem preserving occupations, invariants, reversibility, and differentiability.
A deterministic angular-extension and edge-count bound.
terminal_falsifiers: Two-temperature finite-mass closure fails without an unproved remap.
Any remap loses exact reversibility, invariants, positivity, or differentiability.
The edge graph exceeds the frozen cost budget.
Any required property is deferred to implementation choice.

binding_gate.pass_rule: Exactly one candidate must satisfy every obligation below with no missing theorem, branch, consumer, or numerical precondition. A theorem gap is INCONCLUSIVE. A failed binding obligation is FAIL. Multiple passing candidates are ranked only by the frozen lexicographic rule.
obligations: Process-total finite-m_e shell and threshold contract.
A prospective local condition or inf-sup bound no worse than 1e6.
A pre-output binary64 upper bound no worse than 2.5e-11.
Permanent implementation estimate no greater than 800 LOC.
A same-change deletion plan yielding at least net -1000 LOC.
binding_gate.failure_rule: If no candidate passes, preserve all raw results, archive all three candidates, retain STOP/PRESERVE, and request a new external breakthrough. Do not create PR-01.

exact_test_obligations: Prove NC-SAME-SPACE without assuming the conclusion.
Show lim_(xi->1-) (1-xi)q(xi)=0 for every fixed polynomial q and show the remainders of 1 and p_star*xi/(1-xi) are nonzero with respect to the vanishing ideal/module.
Derive det(M)=w1*w2*r1*r2*(p1-p2)^2 for the two-node basis (1,p) and state why this local fact is not a uniform candidate proof.
Prove the rational entropy vector F=4/625, R=144/625, J=-28/125, A=log(1/36), J*A>0.
Test the simplest fixed dimensionless lattice at two distinct exact temperatures and distinguish a fixed-lattice no-go from a proved moving-remap no-go.
Identify every theorem or bound absent from each candidate; absence is binding.

numeric_test_vectors.expected: Every finite linear combination has endpoint limit zero; 1 has limit one; p has positive infinity.

axis_obligations.wolfram_xact: Prove the endpoint theorem and limits, audit compactified measure/integrability, derive the local mass determinant, and identify tensor/finite-m_e assumptions without reading sibling results.
axis_obligations.sage_singular: Prove the ideal/module and exact-rank forms, test fixed-lattice exact closure, and separate fixed-lattice no-go from moving-remap theorem gaps.
axis_obligations.lean: Provide a kernel-checked finite-span endpoint theorem and candidate-level logical dependency audit with no sorry/admit.
axis_obligations.sympy_mpmath: Independently reproduce symbolic limits, determinant, entropy, and 120-digit vectors; probe conditioning but do not promote samples to a uniform theorem.
axis_obligations.rocq: Provide an independent finite-sum endpoint theorem and a typed candidate-obligation dependency proof with no Admitted/axioms.

debate_protocol.required_loop: self-discover -> step-back -> metacognitive self-ask -> CoVe -> adversarial self-ask -> CCoT -> PDR
required_sections: Strongest case for the assigned conclusion.
Strongest steelman of the opposing conclusion.
Conditions that would change the verdict.
debate_protocol.decision_rule: Evidence and exact contradictions control; vote counts do not.

tool_boundary.all_axes: Write only the registered result artifact. Proof scripts and caches must live under a new assignment-specific /tmp directory and be referenced by command and hash.
tool_boundary.wolfram: Use local WolframKernel and local xAct when needed. Remote Wolfram may be used only as a blind independent scalar check.
tool_boundary.sage_singular: Use assignment-specific /tmp cwd and DOT_SAGE. Never write repository .singularhistory.
tool_boundary.rocq: Use assignment-specific /tmp paths and opam exec -- coqc or rocq compile.
tool_boundary.sympy_mpmath: Use exact SymPy objects and at least 120-digit mpmath checks; no repository imports.

forbidden_shortcuts: Read sibling or prior-run result artifacts before adjudication.
Explore the repository beyond the registered inputs.
Import or execute a RABBIT collision implementation.
Produce a collision observable, T01-T12 result, Radau segment, trajectory, endpoint, or unblinded RABBIT result.
Modify _independent_noqke.py, historical D-027/D-028/D-029 evidence, JAX, Rust, production, shared specification, gate, or SSOT files.
Treat the external 22 synthetic tests as physical validation.
Assume that local SPD at one two-node state proves a uniform mass or inf-sup bound.
Assume that a fixed-lattice two-temperature failure proves every moving-lattice design impossible.
Use DSMC or stochastic sampling to satisfy a deterministic precision obligation.
Relax a cap, norm, domain, candidate, or obligation after observing output.
Promote a CAS subclaim PASS to G-EXT-FEASIBILITY PASS.
Create PR-01 without both G-EXT-FEASIBILITY PASS and a separate explicit OWNER-1 decision.
result_contract: Each axis writes exactly one schema-v2 RESULT_ENVELOPE-compatible result at its registered path, with tool versions, exact commands, assumptions, proof status, candidate-by-candidate verdicts, evidence fingerprints, limitations, and final HARNESS_RESULT.
